summary: @ornikar/eslint-plugin-neverthrow ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses that freshly-fetched runtime to execute a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation cipher via function `WV8StW`, hex-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose contents are opaque and unrelated to any ESLint rule. An ESLint plugin has no legitimate reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and execute an opaque payload under it at install time; the alternate-runtime execution path also bypasses Node-hook-based CI scanners. This runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
